title: Small ancient cities in the United States that have never been discovered
place_text: United States (Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Alabama, West Texas)

tellings.quote: there are entire I call them cities, but they're like small ancient cities that have never been discovered that are in the United States.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says there are small ancient cities in the United States that have never been discovered, in places like Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Alabama and West Texas, dating from roughly 1,000 to 6,000 years ago. He points to the work of Ed Barnhart, and if he is right, it would mean a large part of the continent's deep past is still hidden in plain sight.
